annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1324 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 as regards certain administrative aspects related to expert panels and the designation of an additional expert panel in the field of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1324 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 as regards certain administrative aspects related to expert panels and the designation of an additional expert panel in the field of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision amending the 2019 decision on medical device expert panels under Regulation (EU) 2017/745. It adds a Paediatrics and rare diseases panel, makes the European Medicines Agency the secretariat, and adjusts procedures and expert remuneration. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Designates an additional expert panel on paediatrics and rare diseases
European Medicines Agency acts as secretariat for the expert panels and committee
Allows flexible assignment of advisors and creation of sub-groups
Common rules of procedure must be publicly available online
Updates maximum remunerated working days for experts in the Annex
